claims.quote: the essential DNA strand break repair enzyme PNKP (polynucleotide kinase 3'-phosphatase)
PNKP (polynucleotide kinase 3'-phosphatase) interacts with, and is inactivated by, the mutant ATXN3,

claims.object_text: inefficient DNA repair; persistent accumulation of DNA damage/strand breaks
claims.quote: resulting in inefficient DNA repair, persistent accumulation of DNA damage/strand breaks,

claims.object_text: chronic activation of the DNA damage-response ATM signaling pathway
claims.quote: and subsequent chronic activation of the DNA damage-response ataxia telangiectasia-mutated (ATM) signaling pathway in SCA3.

claims.object_text: activation of ATM and downstream p53 and protein kinase C-δ pro-apoptotic pathways leading to neuronal dysfunction and death
claims.quote: persistent accumulation of DNA damage/strand breaks and chronic activation of the serine/threonine kinase ATM and the downstream p53 and protein kinase C-δ pro-apoptotic pathways trigger neuronal dysfunction and eventually neuronal death in SCA3.

claims.object_text: PNKP overexpression blocks mutant ATXN3-mediated cell death
claims.quote: Either PNKP overexpression or pharmacological inhibition of ATM dramatically blocked mutant ATXN3-mediated cell death.
provides a molecular basis for neurodegeneration due to PNKP inactivation in SCA3
